description: ROM Ali Command Motions & Button-Mash Rapid Attack

routines.name: ali_motion_dispatcher
routines.purpose: Dispatches special motions 0x8814, 0x86B4, 0x8778, 0x8910, 0x8950, or default hits

routines.name: ali_button_mash_counter
routines.purpose: Scans 8 ring-buffer frames for Button A taps; >=8 taps forces rapid-fire combo at frame 8

routines.name: ali_motion_slide_attack
routines.purpose: Ground slide state 0x40 / anim 0x46 with SFX 0x600343 and 18-frame invulnerability

routines.name: ali_motion_somersault_flip
routines.purpose: Super somersault state 0x56 / anim 0x64 with vertical impulse 0x84000 and SFX 0x800220

routines.name: ali_motion_dash_leap
routines.purpose: Dash leap state 0x62 / anim 0x70 with vertical impulse 0x30000, speed 0x100, SFX 0x800220

routines.name: ali_motion_cartwheel
routines.purpose: Cartwheel evasion state 0x72 / anim 0x7A with SFX 0x80025B

routines.name: ali_motion_grand_dash_strike
routines.purpose: Grand dash strike state 0x74 / anim 0x80 with speed 0x600 and SFX 0x7004D3
